Asset: ONE higher-detail portrait map panel, part of a two-panel Glowhaven master. Image 1 is the EXACT PANEL TO REFINE. Image 2 is the AUTHOR-ADJUSTED MASTER, context for matching scale/light/style ONLY. The author's manual composition overrides any earlier generated maps. Return only the exact portrait panel covered by Image 1, same crop and 2:3 aspect ratio, at the highest available native portrait resolution. Do not show the full master, no zooming/camera changes, no crop drift, no borders or insets.

Primary request: re-illustrate the existing shapes into genuinely crisp fine architectural and terrain DETAIL at this closer panel view. Preserve all positions, footprints, building counts/density, relative sizes, street centerlines, skyline/terrain contours and landmarks. Individual tiny houses should resolve into believable small buildings with clean roof ridges/eaves, separate roof planes, chimneys, dormers where room permits, legible masonry/timber walls and discreet doors/windows. Narrow streets have clean paving edges and stay open; roofs must not merge into buttery clay mounds. Detail means more precisely drawn surface/construction, NOT bigger houses, towers, landmarks, roof shapes or more crowded streets. Keep the colosseum/Crucible as the large-building scale reference. Country houses remain the size of comparable city houses. Multiple-building academy campuses remain compounds, not colossal single castles.

Rendering: fine professional 2D fantasy architectural atlas illustration, lively but clear ink-like contours and controlled painted fills, precise matte materials, distinct tiny trees and rocks, fine foliage grouping, layered stone outcrops, readable river banks and bridge arches. Replace soft ambiguous blobs with considered structures inside their existing footprints. Avoid plastic 3D, rounded clay, smudged/oily paint, garish outlines, noisy fake sharpening or halos. MATCH source natural daylight, saturation, white balance and shadow direction; no saturation boost or new orange/blue grade. SAME established western fantasy architecture; no Akitsuhara/Japanese substitutions. No labels, pins, grid, UI, text or watermark.

The LEFT and RIGHT vertical edges are fixed cut lines of the master. All routes, wall arcs, rooftops, water and fields crossing any edge must enter/exit at the exact same proportions and angles as the reference. Preserve the partial features clipped by the crop; do not move whole landmarks into view or complete them inside the panel. Seam repair will be done later in Photoshop. No artificial edge cloud/forest screen. This is detailed artwork, not a redesign or automatic seamless-composite claim.
